description: This file defines the CyclicBuffer class within the Thunder::Core namespace, providing an interface for a process-wide, shared cyclic buffer with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management functionalities. It includes class definitions, methods, and internal data structures for buffer operations.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer
classes.description: A class providing shared, process-wide cyclic buffer functionality with locking, reading, writing, and buffer management.

classes.name: CyclicBuffer::Cursor
classes.description: A nested class used for peeking and navigating within the cyclic buffer.

methods.name: CyclicBuffer
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the cyclic buffer with file or buffer parameters.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the cyclic buffer for operations.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the buffer for exclusive access, optionally waiting for data presence.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Releases the lock on the buffer.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Non-destructive read of data from the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Destructive read, advancing the tail pointer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer, advancing the head.

methods.name: Reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for writing without immediately writing data.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Notification method indicating data is available.
